title: UK PM backs Ofcom to take "tough action" under the OSA against social media sites failing to remove dangerous driving videos after a crash killed seven people (Raphael Boyd/The Guardian)
summary: Raphael Boyd / The Guardian: UK PM backs Ofcom to take “tough action” under the OSA against social media sites failing to remove dangerous driving videos after a crash killed seven people — Downing Street condemns ‘utterly disgraceful’ clips and says sites are legally obliged to take them down
contentText:
Raphael Boyd / The Guardian :

UK PM backs Ofcom to take “tough action” under the OSA against social media sites failing to remove dangerous driving videos after a crash killed seven people   —  Downing Street condemns ‘utterly disgraceful’ clips and says sites are legally obliged to take them down
